END-TO-END 60-90% TOKEN FINOPS COMPACTION, IDE-WIRED CODING & OVERNIGHT ARIS RESEARCH (L1 ➔ L4)
1. Shell Command Compaction (rtk ★87.6k): Strip 60–90% of noisy build/test logs via zero-dependency Rust CLI proxy before LLM ingestion.
2. Lossless Agent Token Proxy (caveman ★122.5k): Compress agent responses & tool outputs while indexing 100% of raw payloads for recovery.
3. IDE-Wired Execution (oh-my-pi ★39.7k): Wire live IDE diagnostics, symbol trees & test runners directly into the coding agent loop.
4. Overnight Autonomous R&D (ARIS ★19.7k): Run multi-round hypothesis generation, benchmark experiments & cross-model peer review in sleep.
CLOSED-FORM FINOPS TCO MODEL (45-ENGINEER ENTERPRISE AI CODING & AUTONOMOUS R&D TEAM · SYNTHETIC WORKLOAD MODEL)
